title: Same name and permissions as an existing role shows a 'Similar role already exists' confirmation
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Create Role page and a role with the same name and identical permissions already exists.
custom_steps:
1. Enter the same name and identical permissions as the existing role.
  2. Click Create.
custom_expected:
Instead of an error, a confirmation appears: 'Similar role already exists', explaining a role with identical permissions already exists, with Cancel and Create Anyway buttons.

Your entered name and selections are kept.
viu_status: Blocked-UI behavior; 'Similar role already exists' + 'Create Anyway' build-verified
evidence: SimilarRoleWarningModal strings + 'Create anyway' confirmed in build.
